module_comment: Rust crates/app/src/career.rs: transactional career advancement and original UI policy for human-club advancement; persistence and complete World are injected. DOES NOT replace the native `.bfn` serializer or Rust full World.

Rust crates/app/src/format.rs: money/compact_money/date/rating/thousands/decimal. I/O: integers or timestamps -> text keys/numbers; no mutation, no UI; caller supplies translator to preserve original i18n vocabulary.
Rust crates/app/src/game_files.rs: image and patch file locators composed from paths. FS/JAR integration requires platform IO adapter.
Rust crates/app/src/glyphs.rs: TODOS os 36 glifos Phosphor extraídos dos code points originais (não redistribui fontes).

Rust crates/app/src/lib.rs::App::new: BF_SCREEN/BF_TAB startup routing. This is a pure view-state transition; `open/import` of files is injected, and egui runtime FPS, painting and interaction are NOT implemented.
Rust crates/app/src/motion.rs: cubic easing/color blending and fade state. Rendering egui dialogue stays unported. Pure calculations follow Rust f32.
Rust crates/app/src/patches/download.rs: download states and progress independent of HTTP. Original networking/retry code is not translated yet.

Rust crates/app/src/patches/mod.rs::Location::github/key/label. Parsing requires ASCII github slug and normalizes owner/repo. SHA key for local files is injected: consumer must supply the data-pack SHA-256 implementation.

Rust crates/app/src/patches/store.rs: storage trait semantics mirrored by a transactional in-memory store for testing and offline browser persistence. Platform disk and HTTP storage adapters are NOT included.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/assets.rs: exact stadium sectors, ticket limits and four-tab asset state. Engine must supply recommended ticket prices.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/awards.rs: nominations, ranking, tabs and full integer display. egui ceremony/rendering not included.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/calendar.rs: a club's matches in calendar order, opponent, venue and scores in local human perspective.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/career.rs::new and screen dialog state lifecycle. Navigation and mod ticks use their own implementations; this is view state.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/champions.rs: one champion per season newest-first. Winner/scorer/coach presentation remains responsibility of UI.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/club_history.rs::placement (selected rules). DTO is explicit; returns semantic marks + translation key; final i18n external.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/club_ranking.rs::numbers/listed/kind_shown. All-time columns sum kinds 1..14; ranking scores sort with stable tie order.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/coaches.rs: coaches filter by country and rank by reputation, using previous country for unemployed coaches.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/contract.rs: contract dialog salary bounds, duration choice and initial salary. Domain offer handling belongs to simulation.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/controls.rs::tabs/segmented selection. Selected tab changes only if within range and enabled. No egui geometry claim.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/finances.rs::wealth/month_name/date_of. Values i64 represented as bigint when large, avoiding JS precision loss.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/findings.rs: staff role labels/unlock keys and tactic description key. Rendering and scouting API remain external.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/form.rs: money field input step and i64 bounds. Provides parsing/stepper behavior only; egui layout remains pending.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/head_to_head.rs: find pair either direction; list opponents by name; match history is season-local, newest first.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/history.rs: all transfers in reverse history order (including zero-fee deals), with date and player/club fallback.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/home.rs: default column sort direction and squad listing. Value extraction is supplied from the game world (do not infer hidden player data).
Rust crates/app/src/screens/leaders.rs `sorted` and career/season rows. Stable sort: goals/assists descending, games ascending, preserve input order.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/lineup.rs::FORMATION_KEYS and selection state. The actual tactical simulation remains in the original engine.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/loans.rs: borrowed/lent row selector. I/O: canonical player ownership, loan records. No UI; no ledger mutations.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/management.rs: seven management tabs and UI state invalidation when changing sections; no staff hiring side effects.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/market.rs::season_deals: positive transfers for the economy year, stable sort descending by fee and date as dd/mm/yyyy.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/menu.rs::page; computes centered inner column from available width, leaving a 16px margin at either side. EgUI not drawn.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/messages.rs: subject, two text fields and body translation keys; translation and World stage names are injected.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/modkit.rs: Cell data builder for statistics and textual tables. Egui painting remains pending.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/new_game.rs: coach onboarding validation, selection of first club by division and seeded random choice (RNG injected).
Rust crates/app/src/screens/newspaper.rs: section labels/colors and selected article read state. Web rendering has not been implemented by this module.
crates/app/src/screens/offer.rs: fields/state and `thousands()` decimal parser. Not a rendered dialog or complete match of offer negotiation.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/opening.rs: opening screen reads latest save; the file system is injected and save sorting is not inferred by this module.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/patches.rs::phase_text/short_version. Downloading stays external; no network or fake installation claims.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/pitch.rs: exact 26 pitch slot coordinates; only geometry converted, not egui painter. Center offset (+30,+25) is original.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/player.rs: rating text fallback and career rows ordered newest-first with total last; panel layout not ported.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/player_actions.rs: retirement, selling, loan-listing actions and time-dependent release fee. UI dialogs not ported.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/preferences.rs::yes_no/toggle/combo state. Translators and egui painter are UI-only; pure control transitions here.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/proposals.rs: offer panel eligibility and manual approval choice. Actual signature/ledger runs in systems/sponsors.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/retire.rs::RetireState::new. Initializes retire dialog with blank name and player position clamped to 0..4.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/round.rs: playback speed and live clock label; simulation and event rendering are handled by the existing engine.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/satellites.rs: financial injection/withdrawal denominations and policy options, with strict membership validation.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/search.rs::reset/filter: persists results when clearing controls and handles seven individual attributes versus overall strength.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/squad_offer.rs: dismiss offers where the player no longer belongs to a human club; FIFO retained. Does not accept offers.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/stadium.rs::StadiumState::new. `default_prices` is injected from the engine; no invented ticket algorithm.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/standings.rs::band. Pure classification of row: promotion takes precedence over relegation; saturation of count-relegated.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/start.rs::new/start: lists saved careers and original saves; import/open are injected, never run silently.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/support.rs: official public issue destinations. Original opens links on explicit click; no network or external action here.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/team_of_round.rs: country/division selection, period indexes, last available year or round; no egui rendering.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/teams.rs: literal state codes and reputation keys; pure state/country selectors for the team management screen.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/training.rs::available. Training available only to a selected club when individualSkills are active.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/trophies.rs::year. Year label for trophies uses startYear -1 + season; the complete painter remains pending.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/widgets.rs: fit_text with measured width; callbacks use real font metrics (never guess glyph widths) and preserve Unicode scalars.
Rust crates/app/src/screens/youth.rs: academy/championship/scouting tabs and selected youth player state; no simulated academy generation.
Exact RGB role constants and position colors from Rust crates/app/src/theme.rs. No font bytes are packaged; actual visual rendering requires separate QA.
Rust crates/app/src/view.rs — selectors used by the app, not renderers. World entities and score engines are injected via DTO callbacks.
